messages:
eli: FYI QA found negative cache-savings in the per-model hovercard after sampling tweaks. example: model=redwood-7b, route=/qa, sample_rate=0.01 -> -$0.09
maria: that usually means warmup amortization > observed hits due to tiny n.
rajiv: agree. we need to stop showing noisy point estimates for low-sample routes. options: suppress, rollup fallback, or show CI.
ben: backend change required. current /telemetry/cost/hover returns a point value. propose v2 returns {estimate, sample_count, ci_low, ci_high, source}.
sophie: UX: show CI line and small "n=XX". if n < 30, display "insufficient samples" and a CTA to view 7d rollup.
eli: also add admin hint: quota throttling may bias samples. show a tiny banner if tenant throttle_rate > 0.2
rajiv: thresholds: ROLLUP_MIN=30, LIVE_MIN=100. config per org. force_live_estimate allowed behind flag for devs. audit usage.
ben: backend will add header X-Rollup-Used and return method:analytic|bootstrap|rollup. will precompute bootstrap CIs in daily rollup for expensive paths.
maria: docs note + example formula for analytic CI would help SREs understand numbers.
sophie: console change: hover sparkline gets translucent CI band, and a clock icon for rollup source. small link: "why this is noisy".
ci-bot: ci: test hover-stats-analytic passed. branch feat/hover-stats-v2 deployed to canary.
eli: great, I'll validate canary against the failing tickets and report back. thanks all :thumbsup:
